summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries' subsidiaries issued $4.2B-equivalent senior notes in five tranches: EUR1.0B 4.250% due 2033, EUR500M 4.625% due 2036, $1.0B 5.500% due 2034, $1.0B 5.750% due 2037 and $1.2B 5.250% due 2032, all guaranteed by Teva. Proceeds fund conditional redemptions of existing notes plus fees, with residuals for general corporate purposes including debt repayment. This is a routine financing/refinancing capital-structure transaction, not a special situation; watch for redemption notices, leverage trajectory and refinancing spreads.
